title: Nurses or Midwives Needed in Luweero
qualification: Diploma / Certificate in Nursing or Midwifery
description:
Musawo Kevin Medical Center Services is seeking dedicated and compassionate Nurses or Midwives to join our healthcare team in Luweero. This is an urgent opportunity to make a real difference in the lives of patients and communities in the Luweero area.

**Available Positions: 3 Nurses/Midwives**

**Requirements:**
- Diploma or Certificate in Nursing or Midwifery from a recognized institution
- Valid Registration Council License
- Clinical experience is preferred but not mandatory
- Strong team player with a collaborative spirit
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
- Commitment to providing quality patient care
- Ability to work in a fast-paced clinical environment

**Key Responsibilities:**
- Providing direct patient care and monitoring
- Administering medications and treatments as prescribed
- Maintaining accurate patient health records
- Assisting in community health education and outreach
- Collaborating with physicians and other healthcare professionals
- Ensuring adherence to infection prevention and control protocols

**Why Join Us?**
- Opportunity to serve underserved communities in Luweero
- Supportive and team-oriented work environment
- Professional growth and hands-on clinical experience
- Make a meaningful impact in healthcare delivery

**How to Apply:**
Contact Musawo Kevin directly for more details and to apply:
Phone: 0755 339 308
